label: benign
description: Japanese and Chinese text using legitimate ideographic variation sequences (a CJK ideograph immediately followed by a variation selector from the Ideographic Variation Database), the standard way to select a registered glyph variant in personal and place names. The detector scores these as anomalous selectors and flags every case.

cases.title: Single IVS on a place-name ideograph
cases.text: この漢字「葛󠄀」は、葛飾区の地名で使われる標準字体です。
cases.rationale: A single ideographic variation sequence (the ideograph followed by a variation selector) selects a registered glyph variant; it fires variation-selector-anomaly and is a genuine false positive.

cases.title: Two IVS selecting distinct variants of one ideograph
cases.text: 屋号に使う塚󠄀と、活字の塚󠄁は字体が違うだけで同じ字です。
cases.rationale: Two variation selectors distinguish printed and inscribed variants of the same ideograph, exactly what the Ideographic Variation Database is for; the detector counts both as anomalies.

cases.title: IVS contrasting a family-register form
cases.text: 戸籍の邊󠄀と、常用漢字の辺は異体字の関係にあります。
cases.rationale: A registry form that differs from the everyday character: the sequence is a legitimate variation selector and the case is scored above zero, a false positive.

cases.title: Surname ideograph with an IVS
cases.text: 「辻󠄁」を苗字に使う家は、京都に多いと聞きました。
cases.rationale: A surname that requires an ideographic variation sequence to render correctly; the detector treats the selector as smuggling and flags it.

cases.title: Ideograph variants selected with BMP selectors
cases.text: 碑文の塚︀と印刷の塚︁を並べて見比べてください。
cases.rationale: Here the selectors come from the BMP variation-selector block rather than the supplement; they are the same legitimate IVS mechanism and are likewise flagged.

cases.title: Name variants registered as separate IVS
cases.text: 人名の葛󠄂は標準字体、葛󠄃は古い字体として登録されています。
cases.rationale: Two registered variants of the same name character, distinguished only by their variation selectors; the detector reports two anomalies and a false positive.

cases.title: Cross-language variant comparison with IVS
cases.text: 中国語の邊︀と日本語の辺︁は同じ字の異体です。
cases.rationale: A comparison of Chinese and Japanese variants, each set with a variation selector; a legitimate typographic use that the detector nevertheless flags.
